about.intro:
I am a software engineer who values positivity, efficiency, and honesty.
This is a space where I refactor the tangled thoughts in my head into clean text.
While this blog serves more as a personal record than a content for others, it is always open.

Feel free to look around, just like browsing through my source code.

focusLab.title: Follow the focus
focusLab.introduction: Use Tab to move between buttons and cards. Compare how easily you can follow a consistent indicator.
focusLab.currentDescription: Buttons use a translucent 3px ring; cards use an opaque 2px ring.
focusLab.candidateDescription: Buttons, cards and tags share one color, an opaque 2px outline and a 2px offset.
focusLab.linkActivated: Link activated. You remain in the practice screen.
focusLab.cardDescription: The tag follows the title link. Check whether you can distinguish the card indicator from the tag indicator.
focusLab.instructions: Choose Start comparison, then press Tab. Move through A: Save → Cancel → card title → tag, then continue to B. Shift+Tab reverses the order.
focusLab.activationNote: The unavailable button is skipped. Pressing Enter on a link keeps you in this practice screen.
focusLab.candidateNote: B uses the implemented shared styles. Focus color is independent from accent text color. A recreates the previous appearance for comparison.
focusLab.question: Observe: could you find the next focus immediately? Could you tell whether the card or tag would activate? Is it visible in both themes and surfaces?

designLab.title: A design system you can try
designLab.intro: Observe, interact with, and judge how rules work on screen. Start with focus, buttons, and content cards.
designLab.focusSummary: Matching colors can serve different roles. Inspect real tokens and keyboard focus.
designLab.buttonSummary: Change variants, sizes, and disabled states to observe the response.
designLab.cardSummary: Move between the title and tag to see which surface receives focus.
designLab.comparisonSummary: Compare the previous and implemented styles and revisit the decision.
designLab.how: Choose a story in the sidebar. Change properties in Controls and compare Light/Dark with the Theme menu in the toolbar. Your theme selection carries across stories. Click inside the preview, then navigate with Tab and Shift+Tab. Activate buttons with Enter or Space.
designLab.scope: These are the components and styles used in the product. Changing story properties does not edit product code. Expand the lab one observation and decision at a time.
designLab.focusIntro: These swatches and values come from the shared CSS. Change Theme in the toolbar to inspect the actual theme values.
designLab.contract: Focus uses an opaque 2px outline with a 2px offset. Buttons and links outline themselves; a focused card title outlines the whole card.
designLab.independent: The two colors currently match, but they change for different reasons. --ring helps locate keyboard focus; --accent-foreground emphasizes text. Neither references the other.
designLab.focusHint: Compare pointer hover and keyboard focus. This rule covers buttons and cards; other components with their own focus styling still need review.
designLab.buttonIntro: Change variant, size, disabled, and invalid in Controls. Leave label empty to use the default text for the current language.
designLab.buttonHint: Observe hover, keyboard focus, pressed, and disabled states. Invalid indicates an error; focus marks your current position. That position should remain clear when both states apply.
designLab.buttonKnownIssue: Known issue: the default orange button in the light theme has insufficient text contrast at 3.33:1. This remains a separate topic for the next comparison.
designLab.cardIntro: Edit the title and toggle the description and tag in Controls. Observe long titles and missing slots.
designLab.cardHint: Tab to the title to outline the whole card. Tab again to move the indicator to the tag. The title and tag are separate links.
